name: Rachael Spring
source:
Rachael is the overachieving daughter of Edward and Davina Spring, members of one of the founding families of Wellsprings Valley. Unlike Theo, she strives to follow in the footsteps of her ancestors - leading the new generation into a prosperous future.

Although she can be single minded when it comes to her studies, there's nothing she won't do for her friends. She is loyal to the end, even when secrets threaten to destroy her hometown of Wellsprings.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/welcome-rachael-47604551]character introduction[/url]]
